Setting up Your Fairphone
Once You start Your device, You will be guided through a series of options for settings. In the below section we explain in more detail what these options entail in terms of data processing. Please note this is applicable to You only if You are operating under the Android Operative System (OS) and not alternative OSes, such as e/os.
While we aim to provide You with control over Your personal data and other data sent by Your device to us, some data is required to ensure Your device is secure, up to date, and performing as expected. In addition, this data also allows us to estimate how long a device is used and updated, which is core to Fairphone’s mission to increase the longevity of devices and reduce environmental impact. This data is sent by Your device regardless of the options for settings You have set and is collected on a legitimate interest basis. It includes the following data points:

Device activation: it allows us to see the number of devices activated, which helps us provide service to You in a number of ways:
Allows us to create a baseline so that we can recognise quality or security issues in devices more quickly;
Allows us to see how many of the devices we sold are active in the field, which can be used to determine the correct course of action. For example, does an issue occur in all devices or certain batches, and are the affected devices in the hands of our customers.
Allows us to plan spare parts production more effectively to minimise waste at the end of life;
IMEIs: The IMEI numbers (IMEI1 and IMEI2) are used for identifying the device. They help our operations team track devices for activities like sending devices to customers and providing services such as warranty service and extended warranty service.
Device Information: The brand and model of the device are used to recognize the specific make and type, which is important for troubleshooting and identifying device-specific issues. The serial number uniquely identifies each device, making it essential for tracking and warranty purposes.
Operating System Version: The OS version indicates the software environment the device is running, helping us identify potential issues tied to specific software versions and deploy necessary updates or fixes.
Fingerprint: The fingerprint is a unique identifier tied to the device’s configuration, helping distinguish different devices when other identifiers may not be sufficient.
Build ID and Build Time: These fields represent the software build associated with the device, assisting in tracking which versions were used and diagnosing any issues linked to specific builds.
Commercial Use Allowed: This flag indicates whether commercial use of the device is permitted, which is important for understanding its intended usage and associated terms and conditions.
In the device setting, You can control the privacy settings of Your device in the Settings of Your device..This data is not used to target You specifically but will instead be used to understand the potential quality issues.

About the data sharing process
Here are more details about the matching process and how we process the data shared to Google. When using the Google tag:

Google will always hash any personally identifiable data (for example, email, phone number, first name, surname, street address) prior to the data being sent to Google.
We only allow tags to share conversion events if sent using an HTTPS protocol, the industry standard for secure data transmission.
Email, phone number and address matching: For matching based on our customers’ data, Google maintains the email addresses for Google accounts and the corresponding hashed strings. After we've uploaded Your data with hashed email addresses, Google Ads will compare each hashed string in Your data with the hashed string of Google accounts. If there's a match, Google will mark those transaction records as matched.

These Terms and Conditions form the agreement between the Buyer or User and Fairphone B.V concerning the Fairphone E-Gift Card (“Gift Card”) you purchased or received. Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully prior to using your Gift Card.

2.2 By purchasing, using or attempting to use a Gift Card: a. You accept and agree that you as a Buyer or User are bound by these Terms and Conditions; and b. You acknowledge that you have read and understood the information concerning the
Fairphone Privacy Policy
.

3. Purchase and Delivery of Gift Cards

3.1 Fairphone offers Gift Cards that can be purchased and redeemed through the Fairphone webshop. You must have an account with Fairphone to purchase or use Gift Cards. If you do not have an Account, the purchase of a Gift Card will result in the creation of an account.
3.2 Gift Cards will be provided by Fairphone in electronic form only, through the provision of a Gift Card Code.
3.3 When purchasing the Gift Card, the Buyer can choose from two (2) delivery options: (a) Send email to the User of the Gift Card with the Gift Card Code; (b) Send email to the Buyer who can then decide how and when to pass on the Gift Card to the User. The choice of delivery option does not affect the issue date of the Gift Card, as described below.
3.4 Once the payment of the Gift Card has been processed, the Buyer will receive an email to confirm this. The receipt of the confirmation email shall be considered the issue date and the Gift Card will be valid for three (3) years from this date.
3.5 The Buyer can cancel the purchase of the Gift Card within fourteen (14) days of the receipt of the Gift Card, without any explanation and without incurring any fees, provided the Gift Card has not been used. If you wish to cancel the purchase of the Gift Card, you must contact Customer Support within the term of fourteen (14) working days. Fairphone shall not under any circumstances provide any reimbursement from cancellation of the purchase that is requested outside the fourteen (14) working days period.
3.6 The Product that can be purchased with the Gift Card will only be delivered to the following countries: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark (excluding Greenland), Estonia, Finland, France Métropolitaine (excluding oversea territories), Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Monaco, The Netherlands (excluding Bonaire, Saba and St. Eustatius), Norway, Poland, Portugal (excluding Azores and Madeira), Romania, San Marino, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain (excluding Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla), Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom (excluding the Channel islands).

4. Payment and Charges

4.1 Our Gift Card will be charged in Euro (€), except for the Gift cards purchased from our UK shop which will be charged in Pounds (£).
4.2 All Charges are gross prices and will be equivalent to the amount placed on the Gift Card for later use.
4.3 The Charges for the Gift Card will be the amount that you have selected on the Webshop, and will be made known to you for confirmation before you conclude your purchase. Charges must be paid in accordance with the instructions as specified by us on either the Webshop, the invoice or by other means.
4.4 The payment of your purchase may be made by the following payment methods: Bank transfer, SOFORT banking, iDEAL, PayPal and Credit Card.
4.5 Your order only becomes final when we receive the full payment of the applicable Charges. Once the payment has been received, you will receive a confirmation email of your purchase.

5. User

5.1 When purchasing a Product with the Gift Card, the User will not receive any change for the outstanding amount on the Gift card. The amount on the Gift Card can only be spent on the Fairphone webshop and excludes VAT and Shipping.
5.2 The balance on the Gift Card can only be used on our webshop. The balance in Euros can be used for all shipping countries, except for UK shipping addresses. The balance in Pounds can only be used for orders shipping to the UK.
5.3 The Gift Card may be used to make a purchase up to the balance that is loaded onto the Gift Card at the time of its purchase. However, the User can also pay a portion of the Product using the Gift Card, and the rest using other accepted means of payment.
5.4 The Gift Card can only be exchanged for the Product provided in these Terms and Conditions and may in no case be exchanged for the monetary value of the Gift Card.
5.5 The Gift Card may not be combined with other Gift Cards.
5.6 The Gift Card does not have a repayment value and cannot be exchanged for cash, nor can an advance payment in cash be made for any portion of the balance loaded onto the Gift Card at the time of its purchase.
5.7 When purchasing the Product with the Gift Card, the general Terms and Conditions of Purchase apply, including your right to Cool-off within 14 days from the receipt of the Product. In the event that you exercise this right, you will be reimbursed the monetary value of the Gift Card in the form of a voucher for use at a later stage.

6. Term of Validity

6.1 The Gift Card can be used to purchase the Products in the three (3) years following its purchase. After this three (3) year period following the date of the purchase, you can no longer use the Gift Card, nor can you request repayment of the balance on it. Therefore, please make sure the Gift Card is used before its expiry date (three (3) years from issue date).
6.2 After the expiry of the term of validity of the Gift Card, any balances on the Gift Card will expire.

7. Returns and Cancellations

7.1 The Gift Card cannot be reimbursed and cannot be returned, except insofar as statutory rights provide for that, for example in the event of defects or in the circumstances as described in Article 3.4. The Gift Card cannot be cancelled. Only the buyer of the Gift Card can get a refund.

8. Loss or Theft

8.1 The title and risk of loss for Gift Cards passes upon electronic transmission of the Gift Card by Fairphone to the Buyer of the Gift Card. Fairphone has no obligation to replace lost or stolen Gift Cards, but you can report lost or stolen Gift Cards by contacting Customer Support.

9.2 All data collected by us will be used and processed exclusively within the framework of the current Dutch and European Union data protection laws and in accordance with our data protection and privacy policies.

10. Fairphone's right to termination, cancellation or refusal of a transaction

10.1 Fairphone can terminate this agreement, cancel the Gift Card or refuse a transaction if we suspect that the Gift Card is being used in a fraudulent, improper or unlawful manner, or if we have reason to assume that you are in breach of this agreement.

11.1 Fairphone accepts no liability for loss, theft, destruction or improper use of Gift Cards, unless this is the result of negligence on the part of Fairphone.
11.2 Fairphone cannot be held liable for loss of turnover, use, profit, expected profit, contracts, income, goodwill or expected savings; loss of details or of use of details; or consequential loss, extraordinary loss or indirect loss, including if it has been informed of the possibility of such loss.

the Gift Card is cancelled by Fairphone;

death or personal injury due to negligence;
deliberate deception;
any other form of liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited.

The Keep Club is Fairphone’s referral and loyalty program which helps Fairphone reward its community for maintaining their Fairphone products as long as possible and promote Fairphone amongst their Friends and Family. Keep Club was launched on 30th September 2023. As a Member of the Keep Club, You are able to collect Points which you can then redeem on our webshop for a discount or donate to our long-standing partner
Alliance for Responsible Mining
(ARM).
To participate in the Keep Club, You agree to the following Keep Club Terms and Conditions.

‘
Advocate

‘
Discount
’ means the discount on an order obtained after converting a selected amount of available points in the checkout page of our Webshop.
‘
Donation
’ means to benefit a cause. Any donations made through the Keep Club go in-full to our long-term partner Alliance for Responsible Mining (ARM). From the total amount of donations, we purchase so-called Fairmined gold credits on a quarterly basis from them. You can find more here.

2. Joining the Keep Club

2.1 The Keep Club is Fairphone’s loyalty and referral program which is free to join and allows members to earn Points for activities such as; making a purchase for specific products, referring a friend and much more. The Keep Club is open to You if You are located in the European Continent.
2.2 If You are using an alternative software, some activities of the Keep Club may not be accessible to you (i.e. get points on your Phone’s Birthday).
2.3 By participating in the Keep Club, You agree that you have read, understood and agreed to these Terms, our Privacy Policy and the Terms and Conditions of Sale. We encourage You to read the related policies and/or FAQs to better understand the Terms which apply to the Keep Club.

3. Registering for the Keep Club

3.1 The Keep Club will be accessible to all Fairphone customers. In order to participate in the Keep Club, You need to create an account on
our website
and opt-in to joining the Keep Club. The following information will be required for your registration: email address, first name, last name and password.
3.2 Only one account should be associated with a single member and a single email address. This account will be the one you use for any activity on our website such as purchases, tracking your past orders etc. If you already had an account with us make sure to log into this one instead of creating a new one.
3.3 Once You have registered, You will receive a confirmation via email. You will then be able to access your personal Keep Club account.
3.4 Later in 2024, You will also be able to access the Keep Club via My Fairphone App. Kindly note that use of the My Fairphone App might entail messages, data and other charges from your mobile service provider. Fairphone shall not be responsible for any data charges or other costs associated with the use of the
My Fairphone App.

4. How the Keep Club works

4.1 The Keep Club is a way for Fairphone to reward you for keeping your Fairphone in use as long as possible as well as promoting Fairphone’s mission amongst your Friends and Family. By joining the Keep Club you will have access to build up Points which You can redeem for discounts or donate to a charity. Points can be redeemed for any purchase value above ten (10) Euro.
4.2 You can view Your Points under
Your Keep Club account
and track your progress and tier status. You maintain Your Points for 3 years after which the Points which You have not yet redeemed will automatically expire. Whenever You reach a new Tier, you have 12 months to collect new Points. If you have not collected any new Points during the 12 months following the accession to this new Tier, you will automatically be downgraded to the previous Tier.
4.3 Any Points will be awarded within 6 weeks of the action being completed.
4.4 The Keep Club will have three Tiers; Copper, Silver and Gold. By collecting Points, You will have the ability to move up in Tier and access different benefits as indicated on the landing page. Upon registration, You will automatically be placed in Copper. We reserve the right to add or remove any Points or remove You from any Tier in the Keep Club if We believe Your activity or the Points earned to achieve a Tier status were fraudulent or an abuse of the Keep Club. Removing Points from Your balance can affect Your tier eligibility and may result in the downgrade to a lower tier.
4.5 Personal gifts sent as part of the Keep Club rewards are subject to availability and may not be substituted for cash. Fairphone reserves the right to offer an alternative Gift of similar monetary value, without prior notice. Fairphone reserves the right to offer Fairphone Products or third-party Products as personal gifts at its sole discretion.
4.6 If the gifts involve third-party manufactured items, they shall be subject to the manufacturer’s terms and conditions for warranty, service and maintenance, and Fairphone does not accept any responsibility for such manufactured items. In particular, Gifts are provided by Fairphone on an “AS IS” basis without warranties of any kind, including warranties of merchantability, satisfactory quality, non-infringement of intellectual property, or fitness for any particular purpose.
4.7 If You have been offered a personal gift and do not wish to receive it, You can simply inform us by replying to the email You received where we let you know you had earned a gift.

5. Using Your Keep Club Points

5.1 You collect Points by completing various activities that fall into one of the following categories:
Joining the club: Receive 20 points for consenting to join the Keep Club
Phone’s Birthday: Earn 20 points for every year you keep your phone! To be eligible, please enter your IMEI number in the required form in your account. We calculate your phone’s birthday based on the date you booted up for the first time. You can only collect birthday points for one phone at a time, the most recent one you entered into the form. This activity is limited to Fairphone 3 or Fairphone 3+, Fairphone 4, Fairphone 5 and The Fairphone (Gen. 6) models running on Android. Neither Fairphone 2, nor Fairphones powered with alternative OSes (such as e/OS/) can be used.
Purchase of spare parts for your Fairphone, protective case or screen protectors on Fairphone's own webshop: For every euro spent on spare parts or a protective accessory, earn 1 point when in Tier Copper, 1,25 points when in Tier Silver and 1,5 points when in Tier Gold.
Successful referral: Earn 250 points for each successful referral (as explained in section 6)

Watch or read content: Earn 20 points when watching or reading our pre-selected content and answering an easy question at the end
Recycling: Earn 20 points for each phone you return through our Reuse & Recycling Program, on top of the rest value quoted in the program. “Recycling” points will only be assigned once the Reuse and Recycle process is finalised, this can take a few weeks.
Register warranty: Earn 10 points for registering the Extended Warranty for your Fairphone 4, Fairphone 5 and The Fairphone (Gen. 6). This activity is not available for other Fairphone models or audio product (Fairbuds, Fairbuds XL).

For more information on the charity which Fairphone will sponsor, please click here. Combinations are possible: You can allocate part of Your Points to a purchase and another part to a charity, provided that the conditions laid down in Article 5.3 below are respected.

Return Policy

Download: Return Policy

You bought a product and want to return it?

You can change your mind within 14 days and receive a refund for the purchase price of the products and the costs of delivery. Simply follow these steps!

Visit our

Self Service Cool-Off portal
, or
Contact our

Customer Support
as soon as possible who will help you get started with the return. Our Support Agent will send you detailed instructions via email.
Prepare your product(s) for return
. If you want to return a smartphone, remove the SIM card(s), external memory storage (SD-card), create a back-up of any data stored on the device, delete any personal data, disable any security passwords and remove any removable accessories (such as protective case, screenprotector).
Follow the instructions sent by email
from our support agent or Portal to pack the product(s). Ideally you use the original packaging that you received your products in. Print the return label and attach it to the package.
Drop it off at the nearest UPS Access Point.
You will hear from us, once the package arrives at our warehouse.

If you purchased your products from one of our resellers, then the reseller's process and policies apply for your return.
Please bear in mind that this Returns Policy is an integral part of our
Terms and Conditions
. Make sure to properly review it to fully understand the conditions in this document so that we can provide you the best possible service.
*For the purpose of this document, Product(s) shall mean Fairphone smartphones, spare parts, accessories, batteries, merchandise and gift cards .
Standard Return Policy
This return policy applies to the following returns:

1. Right to change your mind (Cool-off):

You can request a Cool-off
here
.
For Fairphone Products, including gift cards, you purchased on the Fairphone Webshop, you have a legal right to change your mind within 14 days and receive a refund amounting to the purchase price of the products and the costs of delivery and return. You are entitled to cancel your purchase within fourteen (14) days from the day the products were delivered to you, without explanation and without any penalties. If your products are split into several deliveries over different days, you have until 14 days after the day you receive the last delivery to change your mind about the products. However, you are not entitled to cancel your purchase of accessories for products that are personalized or custom made. This shall include gift cards once they have been shared and used by the Gift Card recipient. If you are exercising your right to change your mind then your refund will be made within 14 days from the day on which we receive the products back from you or, if earlier, the day on which you provide us with acceptable evidence that you have sent the products back to us. You are obligated to send back the product to the address provided by
Customer Support
, without undue delay and in any event not later than 14 days from the day on which you have communicated your decision to withdraw from the contract. Fairphone shall bear your costs of sending the product back to us, except where you have sent the device to the incorrect address or if you have expressly opted for a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us.
In the case of a Cool-off, Fairphone may reduce the refund of the purchase price (including delivery costs) to reflect any reduction in the value of the Products, if this has been caused by your handling them in a way which would not normally be permitted in a shop. This means You are entitled to turn on and inspect Your purchased device to familiarise yourself with its properties and ensure that it is working correctly – comparable to the conditions that are permitted within a shop. If we refund you the price paid, before we are able to inspect the products and later discover you have handled them in an unacceptable way, you must pay us an appropriate amount due to the diminished value of the Products. Please read the Fairphone
Terms and Conditions
, especially section 9 and 11, for further information.
Fairphone may offer free promotional items with our products. To receive a full refund on a purchase that offers promotional items all items must be returned.

2. Dead on Arrival (DOA):

Products are considered Dead on Arrival, if they are delivered with an in-warranty defect that becomes apparent within 30 days from the delivery and the defect cannot be solved using Fairphone’s general troubleshooting processes. Fairphone will only consider a Product DOA if You contact us within 30 days of purchase and if Fairphone has been given the opportunity to inspect the DOA. In any case, Fairphone Official Service Center must receive the supposed faulty products within 90 days from the delivery date of the purchase. Upon receipt of the products, Fairphone may, depending on the assessment by our repair center, provide a replacement or repair of the returned products. If a device returned for in-warranty service is found to be damaged by the user, the device will be handled as an out-of-warranty service (see point 4).

3. In-warranty service return:

As a consumer, you will always have the legal rights in relation to products that are defective or not in conformity to the terms of sales. Please carefully read our
Legal Hub
to find out more about these rights. Products that malfunction or become defective within the
Warranty
period of 2 years or the Extended Warranty period and to which none of the warranty exclusions apply, as described in
our Warranty
, shall be eligible for in-warranty service.
A repair or replacement will not renew or extend the Warranty Period unless such renewal or extension is mandated by local law, in which case the Warranty period is extended by the minimum time required by law. In countries where a renewal or extension of warranty is not mandated by local law, the product is covered by the remaining warranty period or a period of (90) days from the date of replacement or repair, whichever is longer. The malfunctioning or defective Product that Fairphone has replaced shall become Fairphone’s property. Please refer to the Warranty
here
.
If malfunction or defects occur in-warranty, Fairphone will repair or replace, at its sole option and free of charge, any parts of the products that are defective or malfunctioning during normal usage. If the products cannot be repaired or replaced, Fairphone shall refund the products fully or partially based on reasonable usage.

4. Out-of-warranty service return:

Products are considered out-of-warranty if the malfunction or defects occur after the warranty period has expired or where a
warranty exclusion
applies. In this case, Fairphone will inform you of the availability, price, and other conditions applicable to out-of-warranty service of the products. Out-of-warranty repairs may be subject to additional terms and conditions between You and Our Service Centre. If You do not wish to have products repaired, Fairphone will return the products to You and charge You shipping, handling and diagnostics costs. In this case, we will also offer to recycle Your phone.
Additionally, Fairphone does not cover any costs You are charged for sending or receiving out-of-warranty Products for repairs, replacements or otherwise.

5. Abandoned Property:

For both in-warranty and out-of-warranty service return, unless You provide us with other instructions, Fairphone will ship your repaired or replacement product to the mailing address you provided when you authorized in- or out-of-warranty service. If your product is returned to Our Service Centre because delivery could not be completed at the address given, Fairphone will send you three reminders to the address you provided. If you fail to respond within three (3) months, Fairphone will notify you that your device is considered abandoned and ownership transfers from You to Fairphone. Fairphone will erase any outstanding data and recycle the device as deemed appropriate. You will be responsible for all additional charges associated with the custody of the Product.
Please be advised that in the instance that You have rescinded your Agreement, the Warranty is automatically terminated and as such any repairs necessary must follow the out-of-warranty service return.

6. Recycling Programme

Fairphone actively encourages you to return any mobile device that has reached its ‘end-of-use’ to Fairphone through Our
Recycling Programme
or to participate in re-use initiatives, when the option to do so is available in your area. Fairphone actively encourages you to consider the environment when your phone has reached its ‘end-of-life’ and to participate in the recycling of materials and components, when the option to do so is available in your area. Please note that our
Recycling Programme
is subject to conditions, contact Our
Customer Support
for more information.

means Fairphone B.V., a Dutch limited liability company located at van Diemenstraat 200, 1013 CP Amsterdam in the Netherlands, registered with the Trade Registry number 55901964, VAT number 8519.04.270.B.01

means the Consumer, who is above the age of 18, resides within the European continent, and satisfies the required conditions in these Terms.

2.1 These Terms apply in full to all contracts and other obligations between You and Us, and exclude all other terms and conditions, whether provided by You or any third party, unless previously agreed upon in writing by Fairphone.
2.2 These Terms apply as of the time of the placement of Your order. In case of changes, the Terms and Conditions applicable to You at the time of purchase will apply.
2.3 Please read these terms and conditions carefully before You submit your order to Us. These terms and conditions tell You who we are, how we will provide products to You, how You or we may change or end the contract, what to do if there is a problem and other important information. If You think there is a mistake in these terms then please contact Us through
this form
.

3. Information about us and how to contact us

3.1 We are Fairphone B.V, a Dutch limited liability company located at van Diemenstraat 200, 1013 CP in the Netherlands. Our Dutch Company Trade Registry number is 55901964. Our registered VAT number is 8519.04.270.B.01. Please note that we cannot accept product returns sent to this address, as our Service Centre is at a different location. If You are returning products, this should be in accordance with our
Returns Policy
. If You send any Product to Our office, We will send it back to You and reserve the right to ask You to reimburse any additional expenses suffered by Fairphone due to the error.
3.2 You can contact Us by telephoning our Customer Support team by filling out the form on our website found
here
.
3.3 We may contact You by telephone or by writing to You at the email address You provided to us in your order. When we use “writing” or “written” in these Terms, this includes emails.

4. Conclusion and Cancellation of your purchase

4.1 The presentation of Products within the Web shop does not represent a legally binding offer but rather an in-line catalogue without obligation. By clicking the checkout button, You are making a binding offer for the goods contained in the shopping basket.
4.2 An email confirming and containing the receipt of the order will occur after the payment has been secured. This confirmation e-mail represents the acceptance of your binding offer by Us. At this point a contract will come into existence between You and Us.
4.3 Prior to any purchase, You must provide accurate, current and complete information (registration data), which is required in registering and ordering Products. This information must always be up-to-date, You must renew this information in case of alterations. We reserve the right to reasonably terminate your purchase contract if any information provided by You is false, inaccurate, not up-to-date or incomplete. If the contract is terminated on these grounds, You are not entitled to any compensation and You will be liable for damages that Fairphone will suffer, such as additional delivery costs.
4.4 You may be eligible for a refund or replacement, depending on Your circumstance, if You have not received products for which You have paid for. In cases of orders which are confirmed as lost by Fairphone or a Fairphone Partner during shipment, You can contact
Customer Support
and a new order will be re-issued at Your request and You will be provided with a new device. Unless, the courier has managed to locate Your lost order within a fourteen (14) day period in which case Your order will be redirected and reshipped to Your address.
4.5 If You contact Us regarding a device failure, We reserve the right to evaluate whether a repair, replacement or refund is best suited to Your circumstance. Unless otherwise subject to national law requirements.
4.6 If we are unable to accept your order, we will inform You of this in writing and will not charge You for the product. This might be because the product is out of stock, because of unexpected limits on our resources which we could not reasonably plan for, because we have identified an error in the price or description of the product.
4.7 If You are not of legal age or act on behalf of someone else, note that You need to have the consent of a legal representative or the person in question. This is your responsibility.

5. Our Products

5.1 Products and Product packaging may vary slightly from their pictures. The images of the products on our website are for illustrative purposes only. Although we have made every effort to display the colors accurately, we cannot guarantee that a device's display of the colors accurately reflects the color of the products, therefore your product may vary slightly from those images.
5.2 We may change the product:
(a) to reflect changes in relevant laws and regulatory requirements.; and
(b) to implement minor technical adjustments and improvements, for example to address a security threat.

6. Charges and Payment method

6.1 The Charges we ask for the Products are published on our Webshop and made known to You before You conclude your purchase. We reserve the right to change the Charges unilaterally. In case of changes, the Charges that were made available on our Webshop when the Products were ordered are applicable. Charges must be paid in accordance with the instructions as specified by Us on either the Webshop or by other means. However please see Clause 6.8 for what happens if we discover an error in the price of the product You order. In case You face difficulties upon check-out with Your purchase owing to payment issues, feel free to contact
Customer Support
. However, please note that the issues regarding payment may be due to your credit or debit card provider and thus You may have to contact your respective payment provider to find an appropriate solution.
6.2 The final costs of delivery can be found on our Website on the check-out page before You confirm purchase.
6.3 Our Products will be charged in Euros (€) within the European Union and European Economic Area and Pound Sterling (£) within the United Kingdom.
6.4 All Charges are gross prices and include the current rate VAT depending on the shipping country of your purchase. Shipping and other charges, such as import taxes will depend on the value of your order and the country to which the product is being shipped. These and any customs duties or tariffs that may be imposed on the deliveries will be paid by You.
6.5 If the rate of VAT changes between your order date and the date we supply the product, we will adjust the rate of VAT that You pay, unless You have already paid for the product in full before the change in the rate of VAT takes effect.
6.6 The payment of your purchase may be made by the general payment methods, such as SOFORT banking, iDEAL, PayPal, Credit Card, payment in installments (Klarna). We also offer the following country specific payment methods: Cartes Bancaire (for France), Bancontact (for Belgium), Dankort (for Denmark), Swish (for Sweden) and Sofortüberweisung (for Austria, Switzerland, Germany, Belgium), Klarna (Germany).
Please note that if You utilise certain payment methods such as paying in installments or others, You may be subject to additional terms and conditions or be charged additional costs of the respective payment provider.
6.7 Your order only becomes final when we receive the full payment of the applicable Charges, unless You pay through installment payment or afterpay. Only final orders will be dispatched. Please note that, You will receive a payment confirmation when We receive full payment of Your order.
6.8 It is always possible that, despite our best efforts, some of the products we sell may be incorrectly charged. We will normally check charges before accepting your order so that, where the product's correct charge at your order date is less than our stated charge at your order date, we will invoice the lower amount. If the product's correct charge at your order date is higher than the charge stated to You, we will contact You for your instructions before we accept your order. If You think an invoice is wrong please contact
Customer Support
promptly to let Us know.

7. Shipping and Delivery

7.1 Unless You have a different requirement, then the delivery address entered at the check-out for your order will be used. Once your order has been placed, You will be unable to change your delivery address or contact details. Due to tax and customs considerations, You may only change within the same country of your initial delivery address. If your order has already been processed and awaits shipment, You will only be able to request a refund or You can order a new Product. If You need to change any contact or delivery details please contact
Customer Support
as soon as possible.
7.2 During the order process we will indicate when we will deliver the products to You. Please note that if your order contains multiple products, the delivery time of the item with the longest lead shall be the timeframe applicable for the delivery of the entire order. Fairphone is unable to split orders.
7.3 The Products that we currently offer will only be delivered to the continental European territories of the following countries: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark (excluding Greenland), Estonia, Finland, France Métropolitaine (excluding oversea territories), Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Monaco, The Netherlands (excluding islands), Norway, Poland, Portugal (excluding Azores and Madeira), Romania, San Marino, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain (excluding Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla), Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom (excluding the Channel islands). Please be advised that the geographical coverage of Fairphone Products is subject to change. Any changes will be communicated via
Customer Support pages
.
7.4 In case of Force Majeure, Fairphone cannot be held responsible for any failure or delay in our performance. But if there is a risk of substantial delay You may contact Us to end the contract and receive a refund for any products You have paid for but not received.
7.5 If no one is available at your address to take delivery and the products cannot be posted through your letterbox, we will leave You a note informing You of how to rearrange delivery. If You do not collect the products from Us as arranged or if, after a failed delivery to You, You do not re-arrange delivery, we will contact You for further instructions and may charge You for storage costs and any further delivery costs. If, despite our reasonable efforts, we are unable to contact You or re-arrange delivery or collection we may end the contract and clause 12 and clause 13 will apply. For a full description of our delivery procedures, click
here
.

8. Transfer of Property

8.1 The Products will become your property when You receive them, provided that we have received full payment. As soon as we have delivered the Products to You and unless due to manufacturing defects or lack of conformity as per our Warranty Statement, You will become responsible for them and for any loss or damage thereafter. Please read our
Warranty Statement
.

9. Your rights to terminate the contract

9.1 You can end your contract with Us. Your rights when You end the contract will depend on what You have bought, whether there is anything wrong with it, how we are performing and when You decide to end the contract:
a. If You want to end the contract based on an obligation that Fairphone has failed to fulfill or uphold.
b. If what You have bought is faulty or not as advertised, You may have the legal right to end the contract (clause 13).
c. If You have changed your mind about the product within the fourteen (14) day Cool-off period.
9.2 If You are ending a contract for a reason set out below, the contract will end immediately, and we will refund You in full for any products which have not been provided and You may also be entitled to compensation. The reasons are:
(a) we have told You about an error in the price or description of the product You have ordered, and You do not wish to proceed;
(b) there is a risk that supply of products may be significantly delayed because of events outside our control;
(c) we have suspended supply of the products for technical reasons, or notify You, we are going to suspend them for technical reasons, in each case for a period of more than 30 days; or
(d) You have a legal right to end the contract because of an obligation that Fairphone has failed to fulfill or uphold.
9.3 For most products bought online You have a legal right to change your mind within 14 days and receive a refund (“Cool-off”). You are entitled to cancel your purchase within fourteen (14) days from the day the Product was delivered to You, without explanation and without any penalties. If your Products are split into several deliveries over different days, You have until 14 days after the day You receive the last delivery to change your mind about the products. Notwithstanding this right, You are not entitled to cancel your purchase of accessories for Products that are personalised or custom made. If You are exercising your right to change your mind, You are obligated to send back the product, without undue delay and in any event no later than 14 days from the day on which You have communicated your decision to withdraw from the contract. These rights are explained in more detail in the
Return Policy
.
9.4 We will make any refunds as soon as possible. If You are exercising your right to change Your mind then your refund will be made within 14 days from the day on which we receive the product back from you or, if earlier, the day on which You provide Us with evidence (e.g. a shipping receipt) that You have sent the product back to Us. We will refund You the price You paid for the products including delivery costs for sending the products to You, by the method You used for payment. For information about how to return a product read our
Return Policy
.

10.1 The Products are covered by a free of charge, two (2 ) year legal guarantee period from the point of delivery. This shall be without prejudice to any mandatory provisions of local law.
10.2 The Warranty is an integral part of the Terms and Conditions and can be found on our Website. You can find the warranty applicable to your product by clicking the relevant link:

We may require the person to whom the guarantee is transferred to provide reasonable evidence that they are now the owner of the relevant Product, for example by showing the original proof of purchase. The transferred Warranty cannot extend beyond the period of your original Warranty of 24 months from the date of your delivery.

11. Extended Warranty

11.1 The Fairphone 4 5G Smartphone will be covered by an Extended Warranty. The Extended Warranty does not cover the original or separate purchase of Battery, any Spare Parts and/or (in-box) Accessories. To benefit from this Extended Warranty, ensure that You register Your Product as per the conditions stipulated in the
Extended Warranty
.
11.2 The Extended Warranty does not replace, restrict, limit or otherwise affect your rights under local consumer law or the free of charge, 2-year legal guarantee for all goods provided by Directive 1999/44/EC on certain aspects of the sale of consumer goods and associated guarantees, as amended and supplemented from time to time. The Extended Warranty serves as an additional commercial warranty.
11.3 You may transfer our Warranty to a person who has acquired the product. We may require the person to whom the guarantee is transferred to provide reasonable evidence that they are now the owner of the relevant Product, for example by showing the original proof of purchase. The transferred Warranty cannot extend beyond the period of Your original Warranty from the date of Your original delivery.

12. Terminating the contract with us

12.1 To end the contract with Us, please let Us know by doing one of the following:
(a) Email Customer Support
here
. Please provide your name, home address, details of the order and, where available, your phone number and email address.
12.2 If You end the contract for any reason after products have been dispatched to You or You have received them, You must return them to Us. Please follow the instructions of our
Return Policy
, which can be found on the website. If You are exercising your right to change your mind, You must send off the goods within 14 days of telling
Customer Support
You wish to end the contract and return the goods per Our instructions/
Return policy
.
12.3 We will cover the costs of return when our shipping label is utilised:
(a) if the products are faulty or not as advertised; or
(b) if You are ending the contract because we have told You of an error in pricing or description, a delay in delivery due to events outside our control or because You have a legal right to do so as a result of failure to fulfill or uphold Our obligations;
The costs of collection will be the same as our charges for standard delivery. We will cover the costs of collection if completed via Our
Return Procedure
.
12.4 If You have changed your mind about the product pursuant to clause 9.3, we will refund You the price You paid for the products including delivery costs for sending the products to You. However, we may make deductions from the price, as described below:
(a)We may reduce your refund of the price (excluding delivery costs) to reflect any reduction in the value of the goods, if this has been caused by your handling them in a way which would not normally be permitted in a shop. If we refund You the price paid before we are able to inspect the goods and later discover You have handled them in an unacceptable way, You must pay Us an appropriate amount.
(b)The maximum refund for delivery costs will be the costs of delivery by the least expensive delivery method we offer. For example, if we offer delivery of a product through standard delivery at one cost but You choose to have the product express delivered at a higher cost, then we will only refund what You would have paid for the cheaper delivery option.

13. Our rights to end the contract

13.1 We may end the contract for a product at any time by writing to You if:
(a) You do not, within a reasonable time of Us asking for it, provide Us with information that is necessary for Us to deliver the products;
(b) You do not, within a reasonable time, allow Us to deliver the products to You or collect them from Us.
13.2 If You do not make complete payment to Us for Your order within fourteen (14) days when due, Our system will automatically cancel your order.
13.3 If we end the contract in the situations set out in Clause 13.1 and 13.2, we will refund any money You have paid in advance for products we have not provided but we may deduct or charge You reasonable compensation for the net costs we will suffer as a result of your breaking the contract.

14.1 If You have any questions or complaints about the product, please contact Us. You can write to Us through
the form
on the website.
14.2 We are under a legal duty to supply products that are in conformity with this contract. See the
summary on our website
of your key legal rights in relation to the product. Nothing in these terms will affect your legal rights.
14.3 If You wish to exercise your legal rights to reject products during the cool-off period, please contact contact
Customer Support
for further information on how to post the product. We will pay the costs of postage or collection. Please read our
Return Policy
for more details.

16.2 We will not be liable for any indirect damage or loss including but not limited to: a) loss of income, loss of business or business opportunity, loss of actual or anticipated profits or revenues, loss of goodwill or reputation b) loss due to any damage to and/or corruption or loss of data.

17.1 When visiting our Fairphone website, personal data is only collected if You voluntarily provide Us with it, for example, while opening a customer account, registering for our newsletter, subject to our
Cookie and Privacy Policy
.
17.2 All data collected by Us will be used and processed exclusively within the framework of the current Dutch and European Union data protection laws and in accordance with our data protection and privacy policies. For more information, please read our
Privacy Policy
.

18. Access and Changes to the Website

18.1 We reserve the right to update the Website for maintenance or updates. We also reserve the right to suspend or restrict access to some features to users. In any case, we will not be liable if for any reason all or any part of the Website is unavailable at any time or for any period.
18.2 We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to change, modify, add, amend and remove any part of these Terms and Conditions from time to time. We will notify You of these changes with our communication platforms. However, it is your own responsibility to check the changes made.

19.1 All contracts concluded with Fairphone shall be governed by Dutch law.
19.2 In the event of disputes, You may decide to come in contact with the
European Alternative/ Online Dispute Resolution
. The platform, which is developed and operated by the European Commission, provides a non-judicial redress of any dispute between trader and consumer.
19.3 For judicial redress, any dispute between You and Us in relation to the agreement, including the understanding and extent of these Terms and Conditions will be resolved by the competent court in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. Nothing in these terms and conditions, including this section 18, affects your rights as a consumer to rely on mandatory provisions of local law.

20.2 This contract is between You and Us. No other person shall have any rights to enforce any of its terms, except where You have transferred the manufacturer warranty to another person, within the limits of Article 10. The One That

Lasts

Wij zijn Fairphone, uit Amsterdam.
Technologie moet je leven beter maken,niet onderbreken. Wij staan voor technologie van topkwaliteit die gemaakt is om lang mee te gaan en zorgvuldig is ontwikkeld.

Onze reis tot nu toe

We begonnen meer dan een decennium geleden aan een missie die onmogelijk leek.
Modulaire telefoons. Gemaakt om lang mee te gaan. Eerlijk van binnen én buiten.
Langere levenscycli, slimmere upgrades en echte vooruitgang met elke nieuwe generatie. Waarmee onderscheidt Fairphone zich? Het zijn niet alleen onze waarden. Het gaat erom hoe die waarden in het product tot uiting komen.

Zorgvuldig ontworpen

Innovatie betekent niet altijd dat je iets nieuws ontwikkelt – bij Fairphone draait het om doelgerichtheid. We vragen ons af: wat hebben mensen echt nodig? En hoe zorgen we ervoor dat onze designs voldoen aan de eisen van de gebruiker, terwijl we ook rekening houden met de makers van onze apparaten én de impact op onze planeet?

Innovatie begint niet pas bij de eindgebruiker.
Het begint bij de bron: hoe is de telefoon gemaakt, wie gebruikt het apparaat en hoe lang gaat hij mee? We noemen dit "impact door innovatie".
Geweldige prestaties. Echte waarden.

Maak
impact

Bij alles wat we maken, verleggen we onze grenzen – dat is onze basis.

Het is belangrijker dan ooit dat bedrijven hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen en het goede voorbeeld geven.
Om te laten zien wat er mogelijk is als je je niet alleen richt op de volgende productcyclus, maar ook op de volgende generatie. En dat is precies waar het bij Fairphone om draait.

Netto nul in 2045

We kunnen allemaal een bijdrage leveren door onze telefoons langer te gebruiken. Op die manier zouden we de CO2-uitstoot die wordt veroorzaakt door de productie, het transport, het afval en het gebruik van nieuwe telefoons kunnen verminderen. Daarom zijn onze apparaten gemaakt om lang mee te gaan. Daarnaast weten we dat we als bedrijf meer kunnen doen. We streven dan ook naar een netto-nul-uitstoot.

BEKIJK ONS IMPACT RAPPORT

Maak kennis met de makers

Een eerlijker loon. Veiligere fabrieken. Beter voor mens en planeet. We werken samen met onze leveranciers om lonen te verbeteren en veiligere, eerlijkere werkplekken te creëren. Samen stellen we realistische doelen en zorgen we er met investeringen voor dat we ze kunnen verwezenlijken.

Sinds 2019 hebben we meer dan $1 miljoen geïnvesteerd in leefbaar loon bonussen voor de makers van onze producten. Zo zetten we stappen in de richting van een eerlijkere toeleveringsketen. En dit is nog maar het begin.

Een grote impact begint met een klein gebaar

Meerdere belangrijke Android OS-upgrades

Bespaar flink op de lange termijn

Bespaar kosten op de lange termijn

Als je overstapt naar Fairphone, bespaar je kosten op de lange termijn. Fairphone-apparaten gaan twee keer zo lang mee als de gemiddelde smartphone. Hoe langer je je Fairphone gebruikt, hoe langer je de aankoop van een nieuw apparaat kunt uitstellen. Hier lees je waarom je je Fairphone langer kunt blijven gebruiken dan apparaten van de concurrentie.

Toonaangevende software-ondersteuning

De smartphones van Fairphone worden geleverd met acht jaar software-ondersteuning vanaf de lancering. Dit betekent dat je profiteert van regelmatige software-updates en beveiligingspatches. Zo is je apparaat altijd optimaal beveiligd. Daarnaast kun je in deze periode ook meerdere belangrijke Android OS-upgrades verwachten.

Verlengde garantie van vijf jaar

De technologie van Fairphone is toonaangevend als het gaat om garantie. Al onze apparaten worden geleverd met een standaard garantie van twee jaar. En onze smartphones zijn zelfs voorzien van een verlengde garantie van drie jaar. Geheel gratis! Dat is in totaal vijf jaar garantie.

Makkelijk te repareren modulair design

Volgens verzekeringsstatistieken is 67,4% van de telefoon reparaties gelinkt aan schermschade en 33,9% aan batterijproblemen. Dankzij het modulaire design van Fairphone zijn de reparatiekosten bij dergelijke problemen minimaal en is je telefoon nooit lang buiten gebruik. Je medewerkers kunnen hun scherm of batterij binnen enkele minuten vervangen. En dat tegen een fractie van de kosten van niet-modulaire telefoons.

met de volgende informatie:

Details van het beveiligingslek

Productnaam.

Extras

Een PoC (Proof of Concept) of exploit, indien beschikbaar.

Een gevonden workaround, indien van toepassing.

Plannen voor openbaarmaking, indien van toepassing.

Belangrijk

Tijdens de onderzoeks- en oplossingsfase wordt aanbevolen om geen informatie over het probleem en/of de bijbehorende exploits openbaar te maken. Dit om te voorkomen dat derden het beveiligingsprobleem voor kwaadaardige doeleinden gebruiken.

Veelgestelde vragen

Wat houdt de speciale upgrade-aanbieding voor Fairphone 3(+)-klanten in?

We bieden tijdelijk € 50 korting op een nieuwe Fairphone (Gen. 6), inclusief een gratis Protective Bundle (screenprotector en hoesje). Deze aanbieding geldt uitsluitend voor actieve gebruikers van een Fairphone 3 of Fairphone 3+ die de campagne-e-mail of de pushmelding op hun Fairphone hebben ontvangen. De unieke vouchercode is uitsluitend gekoppeld aan jouw Fairphone-account en is niet overdraagbaar.

Waarom is er een speciale upgrade-aanbieding voor Fairphone 3(+)-klanten?

De Fairphone 3 en 3+ gaan deze zomer officieel met pensioen. De software-ondersteuning is na augustus 2026 niet meer beschikbaar. Bovendien zorgt de wereldwijde uitfasering van 2G- en 3G-netwerken ervoor dat Fairphone 3(+)-toestellen essentiële functies, zoals bellen, in veel regio's niet meer zullen ondersteunen. We stoppen ook met de verkoop van reserveonderdelen en accessoires voor het toestel, en na 5 augustus 2026 blijft de customer support alleen beschikbaar voor reserveonderdelen die nog onder de garantie vallen. We zijn ontzettend trots dat we onze oorspronkelijke belofte van vijf jaar ondersteuning vanaf de lancering in 2019 hebben waargemaakt en zelfs overtroffen. We lanceren deze aanbieding om onze Fairphone 3(+)-gebruikers te helpen bij de overstap naar de Fairphone (Gen. 6).

Hoelang blijft deze speciale upgrade-aanbieding beschikbaar?

Deze aanbieding voor actieve gebruikers van Fairphone 3- en 3+-toestellen is geldig van 7 april 2026 tot en met 30 juni 2026.

Hoe claim ik mijn speciale upgrade-aanbieding?

Voeg de Fairphone (Gen. 6), een beschermhoesje in een kleur naar keuze en een screenprotector naar keuze toe aan je winkelwagen in onze webshop. Voer tijdens het afrekenen je unieke kortingscode in het daarvoor bestemde veld in. Hierdoor wordt er automatisch € 50 van je totale aankoopbedrag afgetrokken en krijg je het beschermhoesje en de screenprotector gratis bij je bestelling.
Let op: zorg ervoor dat je de juiste kleur voor het hoesje en het juiste type screenprotector selecteert voordat je je bestelling plaatst.

Kan ik deze aanbieding combineren met andere promoties of Keep Club-punten?

Hoewel je zeker gebruik kunt maken van je opgebouwde Keep Club-punten voor extra korting op je bestelling, kun je je unieke vouchercode niet combineren met andere beschikbare promoties in onze webshop (algemene voorwaarden zijn van toepassing).

Wat kan ik doen met mijn oude Fairphone 3(+)?

We raden je aan om je oude toestel te recyclen. Je kunt je apparaat gratis inleveren voor recycling bij inzamelpunten voor elektronisch afval bij grotere elektronicawinkels en supermarkten. Dit zijn tevens officiële inzamelpunten voor materiaalterugwinning. Je kunt je toestel ook recyclen via ons Hergebruik- en recyclingprogramma. Voor elke ingeleverde Fairphone 3 en 3+ ontvang je van ons een cadeaubon ter waarde van € 10, die je kunt inwisselen in onze webshop.

Zijn reserveonderdelen en accessoires voor de Fairphone 3(+) na augustus 2026 nog verkrijgbaar?

Nee, dat zijn ze niet. Bij de lancering van de Fairphone 3 in 2019 beloofden we een langdurige ondersteuning en beschikbaarheid van reserveonderdelen voor een periode van vijf jaar. We hebben onze ondersteuningsperiode na deze deadline met twee jaar kunnen verlengen, waarbij de laatste software-update in juni 2026 wordt uitgerold. Hierna gaan de Fairphone 3 en 3+ vanaf augustus officieel met pensioen. Reserveonderdelen of accessoires die voor die datum zijn aangeschaft, vallen echter gewoon onder de standaardgarantie van twee jaar.

Kan ik mijn Fairphone 3(+) blijven gebruiken nadat de software niet meer wordt ondersteund?

Yes, you can. However, performance and security will be compromised. Certain apps, like government and banking services, might not work as expected without the latest security updates. Calling might also get impacted, with more and more countries phasing out 2G and 3G networks. In line with our commitment to longevity, we strongly encourage our community to explore alternative operating systems. Much like we saw with the Fairphone 2, the open-source community provides incredible ways to keep your phone secure and functional for years to come. Switching to an alternative OS allows you to receive securicty patches and feature updates long after the official life cycle. We suggest looking into community-driven projects such as
LineageOS
(currently running Android 15),
/e/OS
(who will continue to support the Fairphone 3 for at least two years more), and
postmarketOS
. By transitioning to an alternative OS, you’re helping us prove that hardware can, and should, last. We will also be publishing all the development work we have done on Android 14, hoping this work will serve open source communities.

Koppel je oordopjes aan meerdere apparaten tegelijk en laat je Fairbuds de rest doen. Ze weten automatisch welk apparaat muziek afspeelt. Zo kun je lekker vanuit je luie stoel genieten.

Automatisch afspelen en pauzeren

De Fairbuds weten wanneer ze in je oor zitten. Je muziek wordt gepauzeerd wanneer je ze uitdoet en gaat verder zodra je ze weer indoet. Zo hoef je nooit een beat te missen.

Dual-audiobediening

Bedien je favoriete afspeellijst via je Fairbuds. Het volume aanpassen, afspelen of pauzeren – allemaal binnen handbereik.

Impact door innovatie

Zorgvuldig ontworpen

Klein formaat. Enorme impact.

Gemaakt van eerlijke en gerecyclede materialen

We nemen verantwoordelijkheid voor het goud, zilver en kobalt in de Fairbuds door te investeren in credits die de werkomstandigheden in de mijnen verbeteren. Bovendien zijn ze gemaakt van gerecyclede zeldzame aardmetalen en gerecycled plastic.

Gemaakt in eerlijke fabrieken

We keren een leefbaarloonbonus uit aan de makers van de Fairbuds. Ook zorgen we ervoor dat ze eerlijk behandeld worden, correct betaald worden en trots kunnen zijn op hun vakmanschap.

E-waste neutraal

Je Fairbuds zijn e-waste neutraal: voor elk verkocht paar recyclen we dezelfde hoeveelheid elektronisch afval.

Klimaatbewust

De meeste CO2 wordt uitgestoten tijdens het productieproces van de oordopjes. Daarom ontwerpen we onze Fairbuds om lang mee te gaan, gebruiken we gerecyclede materialen en steunen we projecten die bijdragen aan de CO2-reductie. Op die manier komen we op voor de planeet.

Veelgestelde vragen

Waarom hebben jullie de Fairbuds ontwikkeld?

Bij Fairphone is het onze missie om een levensvatbare markt voor duurzame consumentenelektronica te creëren. Veel van de problemen die we zien bij smartphones, vooral met betrekking tot elektronisch afval en problemen in de bevoorradingsketen, zijn ook van toepassing op audioproducten. In 2021 zetten we met de Fairphone TWS oordopjes onze eerste stappen in deze nieuwe productcategorie. Hoewel de batterij een langere levensduur had en we in de bevoorradingsketen Fairtrade goud gebruikten, waren het verder normale oordopjes met een 'kant-en-klaar' design dat niet gerepareerd kon worden. Het is altijd onze bedoeling geweest om het design verder bij te schaven, en de Fairbuds zijn daar nu het resultaat van.

Hoe gebruik ik mijn Fairbuds?

We hebben een speciaal supportartikel.

Klik hier voor meer informatie.

Welke garantie bieden jullie op de Fairbuds?

Je krijgt standaard 2 jaar garantie op de oordopjes, plus een jaar extra garantie voor gebruikers die hun Fairbuds online registreren. Maar dankzij het modulaire design en het feit dat de oordopjes makkelijk te repareren zijn, verwachten we dat je Fairbuds veel langer dan drie jaar zullen meegaan.

Welke onderdelen van de Fairbuds kan de gebruiker zelf repareren of vervangen?

Oordopjes (links en/of rechts). Batterij van oordopje & siliconen ring. Oortips. Oplaadcase buitenkant. Oplaadcase binnenkant. Oplaadcase batterij.

Zijn de Fairbuds waterbestendig/waterdicht?

De Fairbuds hebben een IP54-certificering, wat wil zeggen dat ze zweet- en weerbestendig zijn, maar niet volledig waterdicht.

Waarvoor dient de Fairbuds app?

Met de Fairbuds app hebben gebruikers meer controle over hun oordopjes. Zo kan je met de equalizer-instellingen het geluid van je Fairbuds volledig personaliseren. Je krijgt ook toegang tot de nieuwste updates, met nieuwe functionaliteiten en bug-fixes, waardoor je Fairbuds langer meegaan. Daarnaast kan je in de app een snelstartgids, handleidingen en helpartikelen raadplegen en contact opnemen met de klantenservice. Je vindt er ook meer info over de verschillende onderdelen van je Fairbuds en kan er vervangende onderdelen bestellen als je Fairbuds gerepareerd moeten worden.

Wil je maximale privacy?

/e/OS

Extra privacy

/e/OS is een volledig ‘ontGooglede’ versie van Android, gebouwd op opensourcetechnologie.
De belangrijkste apps voor je dagelijkse taken zijn vooraf geïnstalleerd, denk aan e-mail, agenda, chat, internet, het weer en zelfs de routebeschrijving naar je volgende meeting. Overzichtelijk en efficiënt.

En het allerbeste? /e/OS werkt moeiteloos met alle Android-apps, dus je kunt je gegevens privé houden zonder iets te missen.

Ontworpen voor een zorgeloos gebruik

5 jaar garantie

Dankzij onze unieke garantiebelofte van vijf jaar hoef je je geen zorgen te maken. Je apparaat blijft vijf jaar lang soepel, veilig en efficiënt werken – gegarandeerd. years - guaranteed.

Algemene voorwaarden zijn van toepassing

Ontvang updates tot 2031

Voor onze unieke QCM6490-chipset (met octacore) van Qualcomm® bieden we ongeëvenaarde software-ondersteuning. Zo gaat je Fairphone 5 langer mee dan de meeste andere telefoons.

Uitbreidbaar geheugen (SD-kaart)

Dankzij het uitbreidbare geheugen pas je de opslag van je Fairphone 5 geheel naar wens aan. Betaal nooit meer te veel voor extra gigabytes en kies precies de ruimte die je nodig hebt.

Ip54: zweet- en waterbestendig

Omdat het in Amsterdam altijd regent, moest de Fairphone 5 natuurlijk weerbestendig zijn. Je kunt er dan ook zonder problemen mee sporten. ​

Valbestendigheid van militair niveau

De Fairphone 5 doorstond valtests op militair niveau en kan dus wel tegen een stootje. Hij weerstaat moeiteloos de uitdagingen van alledaags gebruik.

Makkelijk te repareren

Geen enkel onderdeel van de Fairphone 5 is vastgelijmd. Is je scherm kapot of moet je je batterij vervangen? Verwissel de onderdelen in een handomdraai en verleng de levensduur van je apparaat.

** Neodymium, Praesodymium, Dyprosium

Onze elektronica maken met eerlijke mineralen is een stapsgewijs proces. We focussen momenteel op 14 materialen waarmee we onze positieve impact op mens en planeet kunnen maximaliseren. Neem een kijkje achter de schermen en kom meer te weten over onze eerlijke en gerecyclede materialen.

​In de batterij

De Fairphone 5 is uitgerust met onze eerlijkste batterij tot nu toe. Hij bevat eerlijk lithium en Fairtrade goud, wat de mijnwerkers en hun gemeenschap ten goede komt. Daarnaast draagt het kobalt dat gebruikt wordt voor de Fairphone 5 bij aan betere werkomstandigheden voor ambachtelijke en kleinschalige mijnwerkers. Onze batterijleverancier voldoet bovendien aan de hoogste normen op het gebied van CO2-reductie en ondergaat sociale audits.

​Onze batterij (en de toeleveringsketen) bevat nu:

Fairtrade goud geïntegreerd in toeleveringsketen

100% Gerecycleerde tinsoldeerpasta

Daarnaast zorgen we voor 100% van het kobalt dat in de batterij wordt gebruikt door kobaltcredits te kopen, waarmee de arbeidsomstandigheden van ambachtelijke kobaltdelvers in de DRC worden verbeterd.

We zorgen ook voor 100% van het zilver in de batterij door Fairmined zilvercredits te kopen, waarmee Fairmined gecertificeerde ambachtelijke mijnwerkers worden gesteund.

GECERTIFICEERD VOOR FAIRTRADE GOUD

Wij hebben als eerste en enige smartphonebedrijf fairtrade goud in onze toeleveringsketen geïntegreerd.

Read our blog post

​De achterkant

100% post-consumer recycled plastics for all the different Fairphone 5 back covers and colors.

​Het OLED-scherm

Het scherm bevat 100% pre-consumer gerecycled indium en 90% post-consumer gerecycled magnesium in het schermframe evenals 41% biocirculair gerecycled plastic.

Fairtrade goud geïntegreerd in de bevoorradingsketen.

De speaker

​De speaker zelf bevat 100% pre-consumer gerecyclede zeldzame aardmetalen en het afdekplaatje 100% gerecycled plastic. Bovendien wordt in de toeleveringsketen Fairtrade goud gebruikt.

​De BtB-connectoren

De board-to-board-connectoren worden gemaakt met 100% Fairtrade goud in de toeleveringsketen, en het afdekplaatje bestaat uit 100% post-consumer gerecycled plastic.

​Maak kennis met de makers

Wij zetten het belang van mensen voorop

Alle onderdelen van je toestel functioneren fenomenaal samen, omdat mensen daarvoor gezorgd hebben. Die duizenden mensen. Verdienen het om samen met hun gezin een goed leven te hebben. et voldoende inkomen en een veilige werkplek waar er naar hen geluisterd wordt. Zonder hen zou er immers geen smartphone zijn.

De hoofdleverancier van de Fairphone 5 voldoet aan de hoogste standaarden voor veilige en degelijke werkomstandigheden (SA8000 & ISO45001). Om onze positieve impact te maximaliseren, komen de werknemers en hun behoeften bij ons op de eerste plaats. Daarbij focussen we op de leefbaar loon bonus om hun inkomen te verhogen, meer zeggenschap en vertegenwoordiging, en aandacht voor gezondheid en veiligheid.

We hebben ons leefbaar loon initiatief bovendien uitgebreid om ook de lonen te verhogen van de mensen die de onderdelen maken die in je telefoon zitten, zoals de batterij of de vibratiemotor. Zo stimuleren we onze leveranciers en hun toeleveranciers om na te denken over de behoeften van hun werknemers.

“We believe a fairer electronics industry is possible. By making change from the inside, we’re giving a
voice to people who cares.”

Monique Lempers

Chief Impact Officer

Klimaatbewust

​De Fairphone 5 is klimaatbewust

‘Klimaatbewust’ wijst op het vermijden en verminderen van CO2-uitstoot door producten te ontwerpen die lang meegaan, samen te werken met onze leveranciers om de voetafdruk van onze producten te verkleinen en te investeren in de planeet en in projecten die mensen op de eerste plaats zetten. Hoe doen we dat?

​Door samen te werken met onze leveranciers:

Onze partners die zorgen voor de eindassemblage en de productie van onze batterijen gebruiken hernieuwbare energie voor de productie van Fairphone 5. Maar daar blijft het niet bij. Door onze leveranciers te verplichten om klimaatdoelstellingen te hanteren, stimuleren we CO2-reductie in onze toeleveringsketen en die van andere bedrijven. Daarnaast is de Fairphone 5 gemaakt met eerlijkere, duurzamere materialen. Jouw nieuwe telefoon bevat gerecycled aluminium, magnesium, zeldzame aardmetalen, tin, nikkel, zink, koper, plastic, en voor het eerst ook indium.

​Door te investeren in de planeet:

​Door te investeren in Gold Standard-projecten in Oeganda en Congo, helpen we de CO2-uitstoot terug te dringen en ondersteunen we de lokale gemeenschappen. Met onze bijdrage compenseren we de uitstoot van de Fairphone 5 tijdens zijn hele levenscyclus.

Snelstartgids

Veelgestelde vragen

Waar kan ik de fairphone 5 met /e/OS kopen?

De Fairphone met /e/OS is alleen verkrijgbaar binnen de Europese Economische Ruimte (EER). We verzenden niet naar Europese landen die geen deel uitmaken van de EER, zoals Zwitserland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Monaco en San Marino.

Wordt de fairphone 5 met /e/OS geleverd met standaard google-apps zoals google maps?

De Fairphone 5 met /e/OS wordt geleverd zonder standaard Google-apps. Om aan je persoonlijke en professionele behoeften te voldoen wordt /e/OS echter wel geleverd met vergelijkbare opensource-apps. Het is voorzien van een kaart-app, een webbrowser-app, een kalender-app en nog veel meer. Zo kun je zonder Google je e-mail controleren, een weekplanning maken, met je vrienden en collega's chatten, op het internet surfen, het weer in de gaten houden en je route naar je volgende afspraak controleren.

En uiteraard kun je /e/OS gewoon gebruiken met al je favoriete Google-apps. Je kunt de apps downloaden in de AppLounge van Murena. Met /e/OS bepaal je zelf wat je wel en niet wilt. Want je zou altijd de optie moeten hebben om je gegevens privé te houden. De keuze is aan jou.

Met wie kan ik contact opnemen als ik een probleem heb met de hardware of software van mijn fairphone 5 met /e/OS?

Je kunt contact opnemen met het customer support-team van Fairphone. Zij worden geholpen door een toegewijd team van Murena, de makers van /e/OS.

Krijg ik 5 jaar garantie op mijn fairphone 5 met /e/OS?

Jazeker. Voor meer informatie over garantie met e/OS,

ga naar ons supportartikel.

Wat kan ik doen als ik de software op mijn fairphone 5 met /e/OS wil aanpassen? kan ik nog steeds support krijgen?

Ook als je het besturingssysteem terugzet naar Android, kun je bij Fairphone terecht voor customer support.

Kan ik /e/OS zelf installeren op een standaard fairphone (met android als besturingssysteem)?

Uiteraard. Je kunt dat doen met het eenvoudige installatieprogramma van Murena. Die softwaretoepassing is compatibel met Windows, Linux en MacOS. Hiermee kun je /e/OS eenvoudig op je telefoon installeren: je hoeft alleen maar de stappen op je scherm te volgen. De meer geavanceerde gebruikers kunnen daarnaast gebruikmaken van een opdrachtregel.

Als je de Fairphone 5 met /e/OS via onze website aanschaft, is het voordeel dat de telefoon al wordt geleverd met e/OS.

De reis van jouw telefoon in kaart brengen

Voordat je de productieketen van elektronica kan verbeteren, moet je eerst weten hoe die in elkaar zit. Stap voor stap, leggen we bloot welke materialen, leveranciers en locaties een rol spelen in het maken van de Fairphone 2. Want: hoe meer we weten, des te beter zijn we in het identificeren en implementeren van positieve verandering.

Lijst van Fairphone 2 leveranciers

Om een beter begrip te verkrijgen van de complexe, vaak ondoorzichtige productieketen van consumentenelektronica, brengen we alle verschillende materialen, leveranciers en productielocaties in kaart. In navolging van onze eerstelijns assemblage-fabrikant, hebben we nu alle tweedelijns component-leveranciers in kaart gebracht, en zijn we nu geleidelijk derde- en vierdelijns leveranciers aan het onderzoeken. Naast het vergroten van transparantie, gebruiken we deze informatie om in contact te komen met individuele leveranciers, relaties met hen aan te gaan en programma’s op te zetten voor sociale en milieugerelateerde verbeteringen.

Bekijk de Fairphone 2 lijst van leveranciers

Verken de Fairphone 2 waardeketen met onze interactieve kaart

De onderstaande kaart is een visuele vertegenwoordiging van het pad die de componenten van de Fairphone 2 bewandelen – van de mijnen en de fabrieken helemaal naar jou. Inclusief alle leveranciers waar we tot op heden vanaf weten, alsmede enkele mijnen en smelterijen waar wij op een hechte manier mee samenwerken via specifieke sourcing programma’s.

Deze kaart is gemaakt met het open source programma,
Sourcemap
. Zoom in, click op een specifiek punt en leer meer over onze leveranciers, bewerkers, fabrikanten en distributeurs. Geselecteerde partners waar we zeer hecht mee samenwerken (zoals Hi-P en AT&S) geven extra informatie zoals foto’s, video’s en links naar gerelateerde blogs. Je kan ook ‘gold’ (goud), ‘tantalum’, ‘tin’ of ‘tungsten’ in het zoekveld typen om de waardeketen van individuele mineralen te onthullen. (Voor full-screen ga naar de
Open Sourcemap website
.)

Disclaimer

Deze kaart reflecteert de leveranciers die momenteel componenten of materialen voor de Fairphone 2 leveren. Het feit dat fabrikanten op deze lijst staan betekent niet dat deze ‘fairer’ zijn dan hun concurrenten, of dat Fairphone een directe relatie met deze bedrijven heeft, of hun handelspraktijken beïnvloedt. Fairphone beoogt te verzekeren dat informatie op deze kaart zo accuraat mogelijk is, maar fouten en afwijkingen kunnen voorkomen. Echter, we zullen de data op deze kaart elke zes (6) maanden beoordelen en updaten. We behouden ook het recht om op elk moment leveranciers van de kaart te verwijderen mochten we handel met deze leverancier opschorten of stoppen om een bepaalde reden.

Als je een vraag hebt over specifieke leveranciers informatie of als je een fout gevonden hebt, neem dan contact op met het
Research team
.

BEKIJK DE HOOGTEPUNTEN

We leggen de lat elk jaar hoger als het gaat om eerlijkheid. We traceren de herkomst van materialen, we ontwerpen onze producten zodat ze lang meegaan en we werken samen met onze leveranciers om de productie eerlijker te maken.

Eerlijke materialen

Wat we in onze telefoons stoppen telt zwaar voor ons. Daarom traceren we de oorsprong van de onderdelen en creëren we vraag naar materialen met respect voor onze planeet en haar bewoners.

Wat er in je telefoon gaat heeft gevolgen voor mens en planeet. We willen rechtstreeks naar de oorsprong gaan zodat we er zeker van kunnen zijn dat we positieve verandering creëren.

Waarom doen we dit?

In de meeste smartphones zijn mineralen en metalen verwerkt die uit de mijnbouw in de productieketen terechtkomen, een gevoelige industrie als het gaat om duurzaamheid. Van vervuiling en extreem gevaarlijke werkomstandigheden tot kinderarbeid; een aantal gangbare praktijken zijn dringend toe aan verbetering. Raadpleeg voor meer inzicht in deze kwesties de materialenmatrix die we met The Dragonfly Initiative hebben opgesteld.

Onze aanpak

We zorgen voor een positieve verandering in de bevoorradingsketen van materialen door een kader te ontwikkelen om de kwesties beter te begrijpen, verantwoordelijker met bronnen om te gaan, meer gerecyclede materialen te gebruiken en actief partners te zoeken die ons kunnen helpen deze doelen te bereiken. Per materiaal zorgen we voor meer bewustzijn zowel in de sector zelf als onder consumenten en gebruiken we betere bronnen in onze telefoons.

Duurzaam ontwerp

We ontwerpen producten die lang meegaan. Dat geldt zowel voor het ontwerp als voor mogelijke reparaties – makkelijker kan bijna niet. Met de mogelijkheid tot repareren in ons achterhoofd hebben we dan ook de eerste modulaire telefoon ter wereld gemaakt.

De Fairphone 3 is makkelijk te fixen zodat je ‘m langdurig kunt gebruiken. Alle zes modules zijn verkrijgbaar in onze shop, van de accu tot de audio jack.

Waarom doen we dit?

Consumentenelektronica worden vaak gezien als semi-wegwerp voorwerpen, die meteen vervangen of weggegooid moeten worden zodra iets beters voorbij komt. Wij strijden tegen een industrienorm waarin de gemiddelde telefoon elke 24 maanden vervangen wordt, een catastrofe voor het milieu. Nu de technologie zich in rap tempo ontwikkelt, zijn consumenten steeds minder in staat om toestellen aan te passen, te repareren en te begrijpen hoe ze gemaakt worden.

Onze aanpak: een modulaire, repareerbare smartphone

Het zou niet zo ingewikkeld hoeven zijn. Onze modulaire telefoon is daar het bewijs van. Mocht er een ongeluk gebeuren, vervang dan gewoon het scherm en niet de hele telefoon. Ook werken we aan software die meer dan 5 jaar ondersteund kan worden. Op deze manier implementeren we onze kernwaarde – lange levensduur ook gelijk in onze smartphones.

The most sustainable phone is the one you own
So the longer you keep it, the more sustainable it becomes. Extending the lifespan of existing phones is the best strategy for reducing their impact on the planet.

Fairphone 2 was the first smartphone with a Snapdragon 801 chipset that received an update to Android 7 - And we're looking into further upgrades.
